description: United Bank Limited was founded in 1959 and operates one of the largest branch networks in Pakistan, with over 1,933 branches and 2,300 ATMs, together with its branchless banking proposition UBL Omni; the bank says the network and its digital banking services together serve over 11 million customers. Its Islamic banking business, UBL Ameen, operates 722 branches supported by over 500 Islamic banking windows within conventional branches, and the bank is a partner in the State Bank of Pakistan's Roshan Digital initiative. UBL is part of Bestway Group, the diversified multinational group whose interests include banking, cement, wholesale and pharmacy.
headOffice: 11th Floor, UBL Head Office, I.I. Chundrigar Road, Karachi 74000, Pakistan

products.name: Current, savings and term deposit accounts
